entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A human scoundrel captain of the Seriema who is carrying a stolen artifact for the Metalman and cannot resist helping a stray, such as the crashed Hopelight pilot.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav pilot and friend, a former Kavaron Memorial Navy pilot exiled from Kavaron for a crime and now returned against the terms of his exile.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A young Monoist who crashes a stolen Sunstar Hopelight into Kavaron, is rescued by Sami and Tannuk, and begins to fall upward after touching the Metalman's artifact.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, with a plasma magnet, an onboard viy and a mass driver called the sling.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Sothera's richest world, torn in two by the Ruin: Kavaron Before, the habitable half, and Kavaron That Is, the broken half where debris falls and the Kav memorial teams patrol.

entities.name: Mordraine Ring
entities.description: A ring of shattered planet debris around Kavaron through which ships must fly, so unpredictable that it hides scoundrels.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The dead-star system containing Kavaron, said by the narrator to belong to none of the factions that fight over it.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav navy and memorial teams who guard Kavaron's tombs, enforce wake crime law and patrol the ruins of their homeworld.

entities.name: Guns of Kavaron
entities.description: Kavaron's orbital-boost defensive lasers that keep world-ending debris from landing on Kavaron Before.

entities.name: The Ruin
entities.description: The catastrophe that tore Kavaron in two and threw subcontinents into orbit.

entities.name: Sigma's Reach
entities.description: The place from which Sami and Tannuk stole the artifact they are carrying.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: The patron to whom Sami and Tannuk intend to deliver the stolen artifact in exchange for fixing the ship and hiring a crew.

entities.name: The Metalman's artifact
entities.description: A stone kept in a hotcell on the Seriema; when Alpharael touches it he begins to fall upward and a voice speaks through him.

entities.name: Hopelight warmaker
entities.description: A Sunstar two-seat fighter that Alpharael steals and crashes onto Kavaron That Is after the Free Company tries to shoot it down.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar faith's fighting order, whose palestar tries to shoot down its own stolen fighter.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith of Susur Secundi, whose agent Sami pretends to be.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The Monoist monastery-world, called Anuki by the Kav.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: A power parasitized by the Drix, whom the narrator says must be disrupted.

entities.name: Drix
entities.description: Feckless parasites of Pinnacle who know too much.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: A place where every possibility of success is said to bottleneck.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: A deity invoked by Alpharael in prayer, sovereign of fate.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: A strike town on Kavaron where the subedar plans to detain Sami's group.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The place with which the True Faith catenates, claimed by Sami to be the recipient of their signal.

entities.name: Zagachoir
entities.description: A Monoist comrade of Alpharael who died aboard the Dawnsire.

entities.name: Raphaella
entities.description: Alpharael's sister, whom he calls out to in his panic.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: The Astelli captain whom Alpharael names in his panic.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: The Sunstar ship from which Alpharael escaped.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A former acquaintance whom Tannuk mentions when warning Sami against taking risks for strangers.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: A ship Tannuk contrasts with the present situation.

events.summary: The Seriema narrowly avoids a tumbling kilometer-wide piece of a shattered planet.
events.quote: A thousand-gigaton piece of a shattered planet, seven kilometers across and tumbling, flashes past the Seriema at nine kilometers per second.

events.summary: The Seriema flies through the Mordraine Ring toward Kavaron That Is to find a stasis cask for their prize.
events.quote: The Seriema plunges stern first through the Mordraine Ring, toward Kavaron That Is and a stasis cask to hold their prize.

events.summary: A Kavaron Memorial Navy controller warns the Seriema it is off track.
events.quote: You are off track.

events.summary: The controller writes them off as wake criminals, leaving them beyond help.
events.quote: Marking you beyond help. Worst of luck, robbers. Out.

events.summary: Tan notices a Sunstar Hopelight warmaker following them down.
events.quote: Just so you know, there's a fighter following us.

events.summary: A Free Company palestar fires lasers at the Hopelight, trying to shoot down its own fighter.
events.quote: The palestar is firing lasers at the Hopelight.

events.summary: Sami blows up a rock with a beacon to clear a path while Tan flies through the debris.
events.quote: I'm gonna blow that chunk into its buddy. You ready?

events.summary: The Seriema and the Hopelight lose sight of each other as the Seriema reenters Kavaron's atmosphere.
events.quote: They lose track of the Hopelight behind them as they make reentry.

events.summary: Tan detects a Kavaron Memorial Navy team in the area, probably heading for the same cache.
events.quote: No. There's someone else down there.

events.summary: The Hopelight fires its fusion engine in the atmosphere, blowtorches Tan's cache site and crashes into the rock.
events.quote: The Hopelight descends on its plume of disaster, blowtorches the cache site with its suicidal engine burn, and splatters into the rock.

events.summary: Sami lands the Seriema on a basalt plain, and they set out for the cache.
events.quote: Sami sets the Seriema down on a plain of flood basalt

events.summary: Sami decides to investigate the crashed Hopelight despite Tan's fear of the KMN.
events.quote: "We should take a look," Sami settles on.

events.summary: Sami promises Tan they will not let the Kav hurt him.
events.quote: I won't let them hurt you. I promise.

events.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
events.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

events.summary: Sami introduces themself to Alpharael and promises to get him out alive.
events.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

events.summary: Armed Kav of the Memorial Navy surround the crash site.
events.quote: The crater rim is lined with armed Kav.

events.summary: The subedar accuses Tannuk of violating his exile.
events.quote: you have violated the terms of your exile.

events.summary: A narrator reveals that Sami's rescue attempt was a deliberate drastic intervention against Pinnacle.
events.quote: Pinnacle must be disrupted.

events.summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
events.quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

events.summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
events.quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

events.summary: The subedar offers to escort them to Taro-duend if they prove they are Monoists.
events.quote: Prove you're with the Monoists, and we will escort you to the strike town at Taro-duend.

events.summary: Sami gambles that the Metalman's artifact on the Seriema can pass for a damaged singularity bead.
events.quote: "The proof is in the cache," Sami says, gambling wildly.

events.summary: The subedar laughs and agrees to fetch a stasis cask and take them all to Taro-duend.
events.quote: We'll get you a stasis cask for your singularity and take you all to Taro-duend.

events.summary: The subedar makes Tannuk call an old coin flip; the coin lands point facing her.
events.quote: More chance than you gave your victims, Tannuk.

events.summary: The Kav retrieve the cask from the cache and Alpharael from the Hopelight, putting him in the cask.
events.quote: The Kav pull the stasis cask out of Tan's old cache and Alpharael out of the downed Hopelight.

events.summary: The Kav load the stasis cask into the Seriema's cargo bay next to the hotcell holding the Metalman's artifact.
events.quote: The Kav haul the stasis cask up into the cargo bay and park it next to the hotcell containing the weird rock from Sigma.

events.summary: A Kav opens the hotcell and sees the artifact, which looks like a spitball.
events.quote: The Metalman's artifact lies there, in the dark, in a wasp's nest of congealed shear starch.

events.summary: Alpharael enters the hotcell to move the supposed bead.
events.quote: "I want to live," Alpharael says and stumbles into the hotcell.

events.summary: Alpharael emerges holding the stone, which glistens and begins to lift him upward.
events.quote: Alpharael emerges. He's holding the weird stone in his hand.

events.summary: The subedar orders her troops to kill Sami's group.
events.quote: Enough. Kill them.

events.summary: Alpharael floats in panic, crying out to Raphaella, Zagachoir and Slats and begging not to be sent back.
events.quote: I can't go back. I want to live! Don't send me back!

events.summary: The Kav groan in anguish as their bodies twist inside their armor.
events.quote: The subedar groans. All the Kav groan.

events.summary: Alpharael's voice changes and he speaks a prayer to INEVITA.
events.quote: INEVITA! Begin in me thy ending!

events.summary: A voice speaking through Alpharael says it is not a god and has limits.
events.quote: I am not a god, though I was fashioned for the use of one. I have limits.

events.summary: The voice says it needs a wielder who offers a library of moments to alter.
events.quote: I need a wielder who offers me a library of moments to alter.

relations.quote: I won't let them hurt you. I promise.

relations.note: Sami is captain of the Seriema.
relations.quote: I'm Captain Sami, and my friend is Tannuk.

relations.note: Tannuk was formerly a Kavaron Memorial Navy pilot, now exiled.
relations.quote: I was trained for years as a Kavaron Memorial Navy pilot
You still have Sothera's richest world.

relations.note: The Free Company's palestar tried to shoot down the fighter Alpharael stole.
relations.quote: No wonder they were shooting at him.

relations.note: Sami identifies Alpharael as a Monoist.
Sami and Tannuk are delivering a stolen artifact to the Metalman.
relations.quote: Halfway home to the Metalman with Sigma's stolen doom in our hold and way beyond help.

relations.note: Pinnacle is parasitized by the Drix.
relations.quote: Pinnacle is parasitized by the feckless Drix, and the Drix know too much.
